text:
lee_m: FYI product quietly wants to default new tenants to v2 next Tuesday. Can we draft the operational checklist? want minimal surprises for billing/compatibility.
olivia_t: Echo. Main ask from CS: clear console messaging + a simple escape hatch for tenants who see regressions.
rafael_s: Escape hatch should be both API header + per-tenant console pin. api header idea: X-RW-Force-Version: v1. Also need to ensure pinning doesn't break autoscaling routing rules.
pat_n: On the metering side, we should not retroactively change invoices. If a tenant pins to v1, they should continue to be billed at v1 rates even if v2 is default for new traffic — unless product/legal decide otherwise. But we need to display estimated incremental cost before they confirm the pin.
lee_m: Ops wants a circuit-breaker: if a tenant's spend increases >25% after a pin, auto-unpin and alert the tenant + support. This avoids surprise bills.
olivia_t: For telemetry: add a small per-request tag: version_hint (header or inferred), routing_decision (v1|v2|shadow), pin_state, and shadow_score if we ran evaluation. Keep high-cardinality to a minimum.
rafael_s: How do we infer client version when header is missing? user-agent parsing is messy. propose heuristic: if UA contains "rw-sdk" parse semver, else treat as unknown. Unknown -> default to conservative routing (do not assume v2).
lee_m: Console banner copy draft: "We will default new tenants to v2 on <date>. Pin routes to v1 to avoid compatibility changes. Pin TTL: 45 days (editable). Estimated cost change displayed prior to confirmation."
pat_n: TTL 45 days seems fine. also add audit log entry with actor and reason when pin created. Security wants RBAC: only admins can pin.
olivia_t: Rollout plan: A) soft default for new tenants at 5% cohort for one week B) enable per-tenant shadow comparisons for pinned tenants and a 20-prompt canonical suite C) surface regression signals in console D) widen cohort to 25% then 100% after 30 days.
rafael_s: Sampling strategy: base compat sampling 0.5% across traffic. For tenants failing shadow checks, bump to 5% for 24h to gather more evidence. We'll need a cheap rolling metric: fraction of sampled requests with regression flag over window.
lee_m: What metric threshold? ops suggests regression_rate > 0.15 over 1k sampled requests -> create page. but that might be noisy. maybe require 3-day sustained signal.
olivia_t: We should create a lightweight dashboard tile: per-tenant regression_rate (1h/24h), average latency delta (p50/p95), and cost delta estimate. That will help CS triage.
rafael_s: Implementation details: routing precedence should be header -> tenant pin -> default. Make pin resolution a single memcache lookup with a short TTL (15s) and an incrementing pin_version to force invalidation on change.
pat_n: Be careful with multi-region writes. pin change needs to be globally consistent for billing purposes. either centralize pin state in primary DB or use consistent write path.
lee_m: We also need a deprecation alert policy: avoid spamming engineers. alert only when regression_rate > threshold AND customer-facing error/quality metric drops. e.g., fallback to canarying.
olivia_t: Can deploy-bot schedule the nightly shadow-run for pinned tenants? want automated re-eval.
deploy-bot: created job: v2-pinned-shadow-check nightly. owners: eng-platform/eng-sre. alerts to #eng-platform if regression_rate > 0.15 for 3 nights.
rafael_s: UX for pin confirmation: show last 7-day shadow_score (if exists), estimated monthly cost impact (best/likely/worst), and "auto-unpin" toggle to enable circuit-breaker.
pat_n: Billing team: confirm we can show estimated cost safely (don't leak pricing tiers). If not, show relative percent change only.
lee_m: Next actions: olivia/rafael draft telemetry + routing PRs, pat to sync with billing/legal, i'll mock console copy and the dashboard tile. Timeline: aim for an internal beta flip by Friday.
olivia_t: I'll start the telemetry fields: version_hint, routing_decision, pin_state, shadow_sample_rate. I'll add a lightweight flag in config: compat_shadow_suite_enabled.
rafael_s: I'll prototype routing changes and the memcache key: rw_pin:{tenant}:{route}:{region}:{pin_version}. Keep invalidation cheap.
pat_n: I'll schedule a sync with billing/legal today.
lee_m: thanks. flag blockers here. we want to avoid duplicate alerts during the initial cohort. :thumbsup:
